time_budget.scope_rule: Stop at the first failed scientific gate; do not spend the remaining budget by extending steps or adding routes.

research_questions: Can ORION/VLM learn a spatial task-relevance map R while the task-agnostic uncertainty tokenizer U remains frozen?
Does the learned R order matched on-path uncertainty above off-path uncertainty through K=U*sigmoid(R)?
Can a language-facing bridge ground zero-U versus on-path-U driving implications without changing the frozen U or learned R map path?

architecture.stage1_adapter: Frozen producer of task-agnostic spatial observation uncertainty U.
architecture.uq_tokenizer: Frozen task-agnostic U-tokenizer artifact from Stage1-only reconstruction pretraining.
architecture.structured_fields: Deterministically decoded from U, R and K for diagnosis and QA rendering.
architecture.phase_c_trainable_scope: task-risk language bridge only; U, first-pass R and ORION language parameters are frozen

A_map_pretrain.objective: Foreground-balanced dense R-map learning from clean visual and route/task context only.
A_map_pretrain.automatic_next_phase: Only when every Phase-A release gate passes.

B_risk_alignment.objective: Matched on-path versus off-path K ranking with identical U magnitude/support, while retaining Phase-A map gates.
B_risk_alignment.automatic_next_phase: Only when every Phase-B release gate passes.

C_language_grounding.objective: Bridge-only auxiliary QA grounding for task-relevance and driving-implication answers.

release_gates.interpretation: Engineering learnability gates only. Passing all phases does not unlock formal training, Stage2-P or closed loop.

stop_rules.phase_a_fail: Save Phase-A checkpoint/report and stop. Diagnose R objective or support labels; do not add optimizer steps.
stop_rules.phase_b_fail: Save Phase-B checkpoint/report and stop. Keep Phase-A result; revise matched risk alignment only.
stop_rules.phase_c_fail: Save Phase-C checkpoint/report and stop. Keep passed map/ranking evidence; revise language interface only.
stop_rules.all_pass: Qualifies only one clean/corrupt engineering interface smoke. Formal Stage2-L and Stage2-P remain locked.

claim_boundary: One fresh 17-event, gate-staged engineering learnability smoke. It cannot establish formal generalization, uncertainty correctness, native-glare robustness, planning improvement, closed-loop safety or a 200-route result.
